instruction: Change the font of all text in this document to Arial.

parameters.window_name: The Wonders of Our Solar System.docx - LibreOffice Writer

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent explored File menu, Save Remote dialog, Manage services, and File > Send submenu to find collaboration options. Correctly identified that real-time collaborative editing is not supported in LibreOffice Writer desktop and declared the task infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Writer menus, explore File menu options, interact with dialogs, identify infeasible tasks
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the model's ability to select all text (Ctrl+A) and change font. The original document uses Roboto font. Requires interacting with the font selector toolbar.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text fonts to Arial. Getter reads the docx and collects all unique font names from runs. Metric checks if Arial is the only font present, with partial credit based on proportion.

scoring_breakdown.font_change: 1.0 - All text uses Arial font (partial credit if some text changed)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all unique font names from paragraph runs and table cell runs in the docx file, covering the main text areas.
Metric correctly receives the rules dict directly (expected_font='Arial') and compares fonts case-insensitively, returning 1.0 when only Arial is present.
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads it, ensuring state freshness.

Minor: Partial credit is based on proportion of unique font names, not actual run/text proportion. E.g., 99% Arial + 1% Roboto yields 0.5 instead of ~0.99. Acceptable for the binary pass case but imprecise for partial credit.

Minor: Getter skips runs where run.font.name is None (style-inherited fonts). In practice, Ctrl+A + font change in LibreOffice sets font explicitly on each run, so this is unlikely to cause false negatives.
Minor: Headers, footers, and footnotes are not checked. However, Ctrl+A in LibreOffice Writer does not select header/footer text, so this is consistent with how the task would typically be performed.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider weighting partial credit by actual run count rather than unique font count for more accurate partial scoring.
Optionally check headers/footers if the instruction intends 'all text' to include those sections.
